items.evidence: ROADMAP Q1–Q2: "Rust with Axum on Tokio"; "SQLite via sqlx"; S01 Goal: "Rust + Axum + Tokio + sqlx"
ROADMAP Q7: "id (UUID, server-generated), title ... completed ... created_at / updated_at (RFC 3339 UTC)"; S02 T01 lists same Todo fields
ROADMAP API contract: POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /todos plus GET /health with status codes; S01 T04 health, S02 covers full CRUD
ROADMAP Q5: "Optional completed=true|false on GET /todos"; S02 T03: "Optional query completed=true or completed=false"
ROADMAP Q7: "title (trimmed, 1..=200 chars)"; S02 T02 DoD: "empty title 400, title > 200 chars 400"
ROADMAP Q4: "{ error: { code, message } }" with validation_error/not_found/internal_error; S02 T07 central error envelope
ROADMAP Q8: "env DATABASE_URL, HOST, PORT with defaults"; S01 T02: "DATABASE_URL=sqlite:todos.db, HOST=127.0.0.1, PORT=8080"
ROADMAP brainstorming: "in-process integration tests via Axum test client"; S03 T02 CRUD integration suite and T03 persistence/health tests
ROADMAP Out of scope: "Authentication ... pagination ... web UI / React frontend"; Q5 "no pagination in v1"; Q6 "Auth? None"
